title: Load Unit Type
description: Physical definition of a load unit (pallet, container, carton) that can be referenced by movement_rules and replenishment_strategies. The catalog is owned by MasterData-as-Code; elements/load_unit_types.yaml here is a pinned copy (elements/catalog_sources.yaml, tools/sync_catalogs.py). This schema validates the copy and must accept every field the source schema allows.

dimensions.description: Footprint/height of the empty carrier itself (e.g. an empty pallet's own height), used for geometric fit checks against storage_type.default_attributes.size.

tare_weight.description: Own weight of the empty carrier.

volume.description: Nominal loaded volume of this load unit type. This can differ from width*depth*height of the empty carrier dimensions.
